items.note: Rule reproduced: down since the 2023-03 CHoCH (37 monthly bars); the 2025-02 BOS only reset the protected high. Chart: over those 37 months price went from 191.55 (2023-03) to 424.95 (2025-11), with monthly swings HL 217.5, HH 395.8, HL 303, HH 404.7, LL 291, HH 424.95. An analyst would call the monthly a rising range from 291 to 425, not a downtrend. The state stayed 'down' through the 2023-24 doubling because the protected high was the 2020-12 high of 487.75.

2025-02 closed at 302.45, below the 2024-10 swing low of 303, so this is a valid BOS by close. But it cleared the level by 0.55 (0.01 ATR(M)), and the next month wicked to 291 and closed at 341.7. On the chart it reads as a failed breakdown, not a clean continuation.

404.7 (2025-01) is the highest high between the broken 303 swing (2024-10) and the 2025-02 break bar, as v1 says. But 2025-11 traded to 424.95 and closed at 398.35, so price has already wicked 20 points through it. An analyst would treat 424.95 as the monthly high that matters.
(402.45-291)/(404.7-291)=98.0%. Against the visible 291-424.95 range it would be 83%, which is still premium.

The sweep definition is not frozen in v1 (§3.4 defines sweeps only for EQH/EQL). The event is real: 2025-03 low 291 < 298.55, close 341.7. But it isn't the last sweep on M. 2025-11 traded above the M protected high 404.7 to 424.95 and closed back at 398.35, which is a wick-through-and-close-back of the very level the read calls protected (§0).
Reproduced. Since the 424.95 high, though, the internal weekly swings are LH 402.8 and LL 337.7 (below the 359.05 HL), so 'up' rests only on the 14-month-old protected low of 291.
2025-W46 closed at 411.15, above the protected high of 404.7.
291 (2025-W10) is the lowest low between the protected high's bar and the CHoCH bar. It sits 2.1 ATR(W) below the latest swing low, 337.7.

Daily virgin levels are out of v1 (§8, intraday). All six 'nearest virgin' levels are the last session's own POC/VA, at age 0. Under the naked-level reading they are virgin by construction, since no later bar exists yet. They are not untouched levels in Ochoa's sense: a POC is always touched in its own session. The line hides any older virgin daily levels near price.

Distances check out ((402.45-396.4)/11.87=0.51; (409.33-402.45)/11.87=0.58). But the alignment conflict rests on M 'down', which doesn't describe the monthly chart (see M.state). And with strong zones tiling 228-488 almost without gaps, 'first strong zone 0.5 ATR away' on both sides tells you little.

overall_note: Every computed number (structure on M/W/D, all pivots, CPR readings, profiles, virgin levels, the daily layer) reproduces exactly from the bars under v1. But the M 'down' state ignores a 2023-25 doubling, the sweep lines miss the latest sweeps, and the HTF strong zones tile the price axis from 228 to 488 with no gaps, so 'inside a strong zone' and 'nearest strong zone' carry almost no information.
